Policies

Exchange & Return Policy

We want you to love every piece you receive. If something isn't right, here's how we make it easy to resolve.

Exchange Window

We accept exchange requests within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused, unwashed, and in its original packaging with tags intact.

How to Raise a Request

Email us at support@firaangi.com with your order number, reason for exchange, and photos of the item. Our team will respond within 24–48 hours.

Eligible Reasons

We accept exchanges for size issues, manufacturing defects, or if the wrong item was delivered. Change of mind is not eligible for returns.

Non-Returnable Items

Sale items, accessories, and jewellery are non-returnable. Items that have been worn, washed, or damaged after delivery cannot be exchanged.

Shipping for Exchange

Customers are responsible for shipping the item back. Reverse pickup may be arranged in select pin codes at an additional charge of ₹80.

Refund Policy

We currently offer store credit or size exchange only. Direct refunds are processed only in the case of confirmed manufacturing defects.

Still have questions?

Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 11 AM to 8 PM. Include your order ID for faster resolution.
